title: Захват на складе  (Raid at the Warehouse)

segments.t: Armed special forces burst into the abandoned warehouse just as Pavel and his partners finish packing the bribe money into vehicles. Caught completely off guard, the corrupt officials are ordered to the ground and placed under immediate arrest. Let's listen in Russian.
Что здесь происходит? Кто вы такие?
Всем лежать на полу, я сказал!
Никому не двигаться с этого места!
Я буду говорить только с адвокатом.
Let's examine the dialogue step by step. Notice the sharp, imperative military commands and urgent responses used during a police raid.
'Everyone down! Special forces at work!' "Vsem lezhat!"—literally "to everyone, lie down!"—is the barked command you hear in every Russian police raid.
Всем лежать на полу, я сказал!
'Everyone down on the floor, I said!' Adding "ya skazal" ("I said") onto the end lets the shocked suspects know he will not ask a third time.
'Drop weapons! Hands behind head!' Short, barked commands strip away every extra word when tactical officers storm a room.
'Please do not shoot, we surrender!' So much for the tough city boss: the moment guns appear, Pavel is on the concrete begging.
'There is no mistake, you are under arrest!' Six bags of cash in the trunk make Pasha's "big mistake" excuse dead on arrival.
Я буду говорить только с адвокатом.

'I will speak only with a lawyer.' Finally remembering a line from crime movies, Pavel retreats into silence as the handcuffs click. Now listen to the full conversation once more at natural conversational speed.
Что здесь происходит? Кто вы такие?
Всем лежать на полу, я сказал!
Никому не двигаться с этого места!
Я буду говорить только с адвокатом.
The raid brings an abrupt end to the corrupt deal as the suspects are detained. See you next time!
